maturityScale.label: Incomplete
maturityScale.description: Process not performed or partially performed

maturityScale.label: Initial
maturityScale.description: Process is ad-hoc and chaotic. Success depends on individual effort.

maturityScale.label: Managed
maturityScale.description: Process is planned, performed, monitored, and controlled at project level.

maturityScale.label: Defined
maturityScale.description: Process is well characterized, understood, and described in standards and procedures.

maturityScale.label: Quantitatively Managed
maturityScale.description: Process is controlled using statistical and quantitative techniques.

maturityScale.label: Optimizing
maturityScale.description: Process is continuously improved based on quantitative understanding.
